investigation: PSI-101, SAME-R: smoke of overheated spacecraft materials, aged and measured in the Microgravity Science Glovebox
description: W0 law of docs/wsp/research/phys_samer_w0.md, section 7.1: smoke size by condensation and Brownian coagulation, and the ISS detector scatter channel. Material indicators and no_flow are derived from material and inlet_velocity by tools/wsp/ext/law_inputs.py; the other features are case inputs under their own names.

features.name: is_pyrell
features.description: material indicator (lamp wick is the reference)

features.name: inlet_velocity
features.description: nominal duct air speed during heating

features.name: net_aging_time
features.description: the horizon: age of the smoke when the row was measured

targets.name: d10
targets.description: count mean diameter M1/M0 at net_aging_time (lane-local)

targets.name: d30
targets.description: diameter of average mass at net_aging_time (lane-local)

targets.name: iss_full_scale
targets.description: ISS detector scatter channel at full scale, |V| >= 6.0 V
